episodes.title: The DVD
episodes.summary: Gumball is desperate to avoid a late fee on the rented dvd he accidentally destroyed.

episodes.title: The Responsible
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin get to babysit Anais whilst their parents go to a PTA meeting, but being "responsible" has a different meaning when you don't know what it means.

episodes.title: The Third
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin spice up their friendship by introducing a third best friend.

episodes.title: The Debt
episodes.summary: Believing that his life had been saved, Gumball vows to repay his debt by saving Mr. Robinson's life.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin, thinking that the world will end in 24 hours, decide to make the most out of their remaining time.

episodes.title: The Dress
episodes.summary: When his clothes are shrunk in the washing machine by his father, Gumball is forced to wear his mother's wedding dress to school.

episodes.title: The Quest
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin help Anais get her beloved doll back after it is lost on the way to school.

episodes.title: The Spoon
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin become unwitting accomplices in a stick-up at a gas station.

episodes.title: The Pressure
episodes.summary: When Masami claims that Darwin is her boyfriend, Gumball vows to help his friend before he gets kissed.

episodes.title: The Painting
episodes.summary: After seeing a picture that Anais drew, Principal Brown assumes that Anais finds her family dysfunctional, so he begins to meddle in their family life.

episodes.title: The Laziest
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin challenge their father to a laziness competition, with the loser having to do the winner's chores.

episodes.title: The Ghost
episodes.summary: When a ghost named Carrie possesses Gumball's body in order to feel earthly experiences and to eat, he must learn to say "no" to her.

episodes.title: The Mystery
episodes.summary: Gumball decides to investigate when his class finds Principal Brown wrapped up in toilet paper, shaved and, covered in green paint, or else face detention.

episodes.title: The Prank
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin's pranks on their father get out of hand.

episodes.title: The Gi
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin are ridiculed for their martial-arts outfits by their schoolmates, and their mom tries to convince them to take them off.

episodes.title: The Kiss
episodes.summary: A kiss from Grandma JoJo traumatizes Gumball, and Darwin attempts to help him forget.

episodes.title: The Party
episodes.summary: Gumball and his friends are invited to a high-school party hosted by Tobias's sister Rachel, but they must find dates in order to attend.

episodes.title: The Refund
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin go to great lengths to get their money back from an incompatible video game, but the rental store's policy prevents them from getting it.

episodes.title: The Robot
episodes.summary: Gumball decides to help Bobert act like a real boy. However, it soon becomes a battle for his very identity when the robot plots to take over his life.

episodes.title: The Picnic
episodes.summary: During a school field trip, Gumball and Darwin ignore their teacher's warning to go around a dangerous forest and, instead, traverse through it. Hopelessly lost, they must use what very little survival skills they have to escape.

episodes.title: The Goons
episodes.summary: Anais tries to "dumb down" in order to have fun with her brothers and father. Gumball, feeling left out, sets up a race in order to win Dad back (and avoid quality time with his mother).

episodes.title: The Secret
episodes.summary: Gumball tries desperately to find out Darwin's secret.

episodes.title: The Sock
episodes.summary: Mr. Small teaches Gumball and Darwin various ways of becoming more honest.

episodes.title: The Genius
episodes.summary: Darwin goes to an institute for geniuses.

episodes.title: The Poltergeist
episodes.summary: Richard believes there's a ghost in the attic, but it is actually Mr. Robinson, who Gumball moved up there after he entered a catatonic state due to being kicked out by his wife. Gumball and Darwin work on trying to restore Mr. Robinson whilst Richard, unaware of this, sets traps for the ghost.

episodes.title: The Mustache
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin want to become adults and Richard wants to lose weight. After accidentally having their cereal switched with supplements Richard ordered, Gumball, Darwin and Anais find themselves having very unusual growth spurts.

episodes.title: The Date
episodes.summary: Gumball learns how to date so he can go out on a date with Penny, which turns out to be a funeral for Penny's pet spider.

episodes.title: The Club
episodes.summary: When Gumball turns down an offer to join the Rejects Club, they seek to enact revenge against him.

episodes.title: The Wand
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin share the power of magic with Richard.

episodes.title: The Ape
episodes.summary: Ms. Simian cozies up to Gumball in order to win an award.

episodes.title: The Car
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin are eager enough to do numerous chores at Mr. Robinson's house, until they accidentally destroy his car.

episodes.title: The Curse
episodes.summary: Gumball's good day turns bad to worse throughout his school day, much to the point where he believes he is "cursed".

episodes.title: The Microwave
episodes.summary: Gumball creates a creature, made of every gross thing he could find. The creature proceeds to go on a rampage throughout Elmore.

episodes.title: The Meddler
episodes.summary: Seeing Gumball in need of attention, Nicole hangs out with him at school, which becomes increasingly embarrassing for her son.

episodes.title: The Helmet
episodes.summary: Gumball wears a lucky helmet, but it tears his family apart.

episodes.title: The Fight
episodes.summary: After Gumball's bullying problem, Tina Rex demands to have a fight with him.

episodes.title: The Remote
episodes.summary: The Watterson family fights over the remote when they realize everything they want to watch comes on at the same time.

episodes.title: The Colossus
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin upset a giant.

episodes.title: The Knights
episodes.summary: Gumball and Tobias compete for Penny's affection by putting on the lamest duel in history.

episodes.title: The Fridge
episodes.summary: Mom tries to inspire Gumball to develop ambition.

episodes.title: The Flower
episodes.summary: Gumball is jealous when he sees Leslie with Penny.

episodes.title: The Banana
episodes.summary: Gumball seeks justice when Banana Joe chews Darwin's pen.

episodes.title: The Phone
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin get their first cell phone, and Darwin develops a texting addiction.

episodes.title: The Job
episodes.summary: Dad gets a job as a pizza delivery guy.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.summary: Carrie takes Gumball, Darwin and Anais to a haunted house party.

episodes.title: The Treasure
episodes.summary: Anais uncovers a secret that she thinks will lead her to a treasure.

episodes.title: The Apology
episodes.summary: Ms. Simian owes Gumball an apology.

episodes.title: The Words
episodes.summary: Gumball tries to teach Darwin to be more direct with mixed results.

episodes.title: The Skull
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin befriend a compulsive liar.

episodes.title: The Bet
episodes.summary: Bobert becomes Gumball's servant and obeys every command he receives.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.summary: Santa Claus gets run over by the Wattersons, so it's up to them to save Christmas.

episodes.title: The Watch
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin try to retrieve a family heirloom from an old man.

episodes.title: The Bumpkin
episodes.summary: Gumball envies rural life and asks Idaho to teach his family to live like potatoes.

episodes.title: The Flakers
episodes.summary: Darwin abandons Gumball when faced with a beating by Tina, so Gumball plots revenge.

episodes.title: The Authority
episodes.summary: After Richard is hospitalized from an accident, Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger, which leads Nicole to disagree with her parenting style.

episodes.title: The Virus
episodes.summary: An evil virus seeks vengeance on Gumball, Darwin, and Teri after they wipe out his army of bacteria.

episodes.title: The Pony
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin rent a film to watch with Anais, but they keep getting distracted on their way home.

episodes.title: The Hero
episodes.summary: Richard gets upset when he realizes Gumball and Darwin think of him as a laughing stock.

episodes.title: The Dream
episodes.summary: Darwin kisses Penny in one of Gumball's dreams and he gets mad about it.

episodes.title: The Sidekick
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin try to get a game back from Tobias, but Darwin begins to feel like he is just a sidekick to Gumball.

episodes.title: The Photo
episodes.summary: Gumball tries and fails to look good in the school photos.

episodes.title: The Tag
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin get caught in a trashcan feud.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: A plot to improve Alan and Carmen's relationship backfires, and Gumball has to reunite them.

episodes.title: The Lesson
episodes.summary: The guys have detention and try to escape; Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger.

episodes.title: The Game
episodes.summary: The Wattersons are carried away by "Dodj or Daar,'' a game invented by the boys.

episodes.title: The Limit
episodes.summary: Nicole gets upset with the family at the supermarket.

episodes.title: The Voice
episodes.summary: When Gumball and Darwin receive a scary email, everyone is a suspect... including themselves!

episodes.title: The Promise
episodes.summary: Darwin has promised to play video games with Gumball, but there is a Banana Joe-shaped problem...

episodes.title: The Castle
episodes.summary: Richard takes charge of the house in Nicole's absence, but his lack of rules soon attracts unwelcome guests.

episodes.title: The Boombox
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin try to understand Juke's urgent beatbox message.

episodes.title: The Tape
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin fail to make instant home movie classics.

episodes.title: The Sweaters
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin's reputation is challenged and they really couldn't care less.

episodes.title: The Internet
episodes.summary: After accidentally creating an embarrassing viral video, Gumball is determined to take down the Internet.

episodes.title: The Plan
episodes.summary: The Watterson children devise a fool-proof plan to save Nicole.

episodes.title: The World
episodes.summary: The life of the "inanimate" objects of Elmore are shown in a series of short skits.

episodes.title: The Finale
episodes.summary: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences.

episodes.title: The Kids
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin's voices start to break.

episodes.title: The Fan
episodes.summary: New Elmore Junior High student Sarah becomes Gumball and Darwin's obsessive number-one fan.

episodes.title: The Coach
episodes.summary: The new coach at Elmore Junior High stands up to Jamie.

episodes.title: The Pizza
episodes.summary: Frustrated, Larry quits all of his jobs, unraveling the apocalypse of Elmore.

episodes.title: The Saint
episodes.summary: Gumball's snacking in the library causes issues.

episodes.title: The Friend
episodes.summary: Anais invents an imaginary friend.

episodes.title: The Society
episodes.summary: Gumball learns the school has a secret society.

episodes.title: The Spoiler
episodes.summary: When Gumball and Darwin have to wait to see a movie, they try to avoid spoilers.

episodes.title: The Countdown
episodes.summary: Miss Simian threatens to expel the boys if they are late for school.

episodes.title: The Nobody
episodes.summary: When things go missing in the house, Gumball and Darwin search for the culprit.

episodes.title: The Crew
episodes.summary: When Gumball and Darwin decide to join a crew, they are determined to prove their worth to senior citizens.

episodes.title: The Comic
episodes.summary: Gumball stars in his own comic.

episodes.title: The Traitor
episodes.summary: Gumball calls Alan a traitor when Gumball thinks Alan lied to get out of having dinner together.

episodes.title: The Signal
episodes.summary: When Gumball develops a bizarre stutter, he unintentionally offends Darwin.

episodes.title: The Parasite
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin fear that Anais is being taken advantage of by a friend...

episodes.title: The Love
episodes.summary: The residents of Elmore search for the meaning of love...

episodes.title: The Awkwardness
episodes.summary: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy, and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward.

episodes.title: The Bus
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin read Anais' diary and discover her relationship with a new friend is one-sided.

episodes.title: The Roots
episodes.summary: Thinking that he is homesick for the sea, the family try to make Darwin connect with his roots.

episodes.title: The Disaster (Part 1)
episodes.summary: When Rob purchases a universal remote from the Awesome Store, he discovers can control the entire universe. He rewinds into the past and remembersGumball had left him in The Void, leaving him scarred and in his current mutated shape. He uses the universal remote to destroy Gumball's life, whilst Gumball has to figure out what's going on before he's ejected once and for all.

episodes.title: The Vision
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin stumble upon Alan's "Manifesto on how I will gain the power I need to purge Elmore Jr High of its greatest problem".

episodes.title: The Choices
episodes.summary: While reminiscing about meeting Richard, Nicole wonders if her life would have been better if she'd taken a different path.

episodes.title: The Code
episodes.summary: After learning they cannot live without wi-fi, Gumball and Darwin try to obtain Mr. Robinson's passcode so they can go online again

episodes.title: The Scam
episodes.summary: Carrie backs up Gumball's story about a monster, and the students want to hire them as ghost exterminators for Halloween candy.

episodes.title: The Test
episodes.summary: When he is labeled a ``loser'' in an online test, Gumball believes he must do the opposite of everything he would normally do.

episodes.title: The Slide
episodes.summary: Rocky decides to stop living life online, and find love on a dating app, and Gumball and Darwin try to help him.

episodes.title: The Loophole
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin give Bobert instructions so he will behave in a safe and responsible manner, but he applies the logic to their rules.

episodes.title: The Copycats
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Kiki and Quack, a pair of siblings that copy everything they do and say; Gumball and Darwin find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

episodes.title: The Potato
episodes.summary: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato. However, he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

episodes.title: The Fuss
episodes.summary: Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day; Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

episodes.title: The Outside
episodes.summary: The family goes to visit Richard's dad; Based on his basic living standards and extended absence from Richard's life, they assume Frankie must have done a stretch in the slammer.

episodes.title: The Vase
episodes.summary: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and accidentally break her latest hideous vase; when Gumball, Darwin and Anais try to destroy the vase, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

episodes.title: The Matchmaker
episodes.summary: Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.summary: The Wattersons receive an unmarked package in the mail; to distract themselves from the urge to open the package, the Wattersons all take turns to imagine what it might contain.

episodes.title: The Console
episodes.summary: When Gumball is given a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world; Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

episodes.title: The Ollie
episodes.summary: When Darwin asks Gumball to teach him how to skate, Gumball makes sure he covers every aspect of the skating lifestyle from wearing the right gear, using the right terms and choosing the right board, but forgets to teach him how to skate.

episodes.title: The Catfish
episodes.summary: When Gumball and Darwin realize Grandpa Louie has no friends, they create one called Muriel, when Granny Jojo finds out Louie has been spending time online with another ``woman,'' Muriel not existing isn't going to stop her from being destroyed.

episodes.title: The Cycle
episodes.summary: Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Mr. Wilson has been picking on their Dad for most of his life, so they try to get back at Mr Wilson to break the cycle.

episodes.title: The Stars
episodes.summary: When Dad gives Larry's hairdresser a bad review for saying he's bald, Gumball and Darwin are inspired to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review.

episodes.title: The Grades
episodes.summary: When a failed test grade brings down Gumball's grade point average, Gumball is forced to return to kindergarten.

episodes.title: The Diet
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin find out why Dad's diet was not working, and after they help him lose weight, Richard becomes more obnoxious.

episodes.title: The Ex
episodes.summary: When Gumball learns that his nemesis has found a new nemesis, Gumball tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship."

episodes.title: The Sorcerer
episodes.summary: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that doesn't have special powers; Gumball convinces Mrs. Jotunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

episodes.title: The Menu
episodes.summary: When Richard hears the urban legend of a secret Joyful Burger, he will stop at nothing to devour it.

episodes.title: The Uncle
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin are desperate to meet Ocho's famous uncle.

episodes.title: The Weirdo
episodes.summary: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird.

episodes.title: The Heist
episodes.summary: Richard wears a motorcycle helmet into a bank, with poor results.

episodes.title: The Singing
episodes.summary: Joining the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

episodes.title: The Best
episodes.summary: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

episodes.title: The Worst
episodes.summary: The Wattersons compete over who has the worst life.

episodes.title: The Deal
episodes.summary: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

episodes.title: The Petals
episodes.summary: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him

episodes.title: The Puppets
episodes.summary: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

episodes.title: The Nuisance
episodes.summary: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

episodes.title: The Line
episodes.summary: The Wattersons and all of Elmore do whatever it takes to be the first ones at the new screening of theStar Wars-esque sci-fi space drama,Stellar Odyssey: The Force Rehashes.

episodes.title: The List
episodes.summary: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

episodes.title: The News
episodes.summary: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

episodes.title: The Rival
episodes.summary: Back in time to when Anais is a newborn baby, Gumball and Darwin are terrified of her sinister and evil nature of trying to get the boys in trouble and killed. They decide to ship her away, but her box ends up getting picked up by the garbage disposal, forcing the boys to go and rescue her.

episodes.title: The Lady
episodes.summary: Gumball and Darwin become suspicious of Richard's connection to a woman named Samantha who is always hanging out with a group of old ladies. When they realize that Richard and Samantha are one and the same, they set out to right a wrong.

episodes.title: The Sucker
episodes.summary: Darwin ends up in detention with Julius Oppenheimer Jr. for trying to fix Julius' vandalism, and Julius cons Darwin into being part of his gang... but soon regrets it when everything Darwin does goes wrong.

episodes.title: The Pact
episodes.summary: Gumball and Principal Brown make a pact to tell each other's girlfriends about problems they have.

episodes.title: The Brain
episodes.summary: The Wattersons have to stop doing stupid things in order to prevent Anais from falling into a coma from facepalming too much.

episodes.title: The Ghouls
episodes.summary: Halloween isn't what it used to be. Can Gumball and Darwin help the ghouls get their scare back?

episodes.title: The Stink
episodes.summary: Gumball questions Mr. Small's eco-friendly commitment, causing him to abandon society and live in the forest.

episodes.title: The Awareness
episodes.summary: Gumball's plant-insensitivity causes problems with Leslie.

episodes.title: The Slip
episodes.summary: Richard misses a package and is forced into an escalating feud with the delivery guy.

episodes.title: The Drama
episodes.summary: Gumball tries to protect Darwin from his unsuitable undead girlfriend Carrie.

episodes.title: The Buddy
episodes.summary: Anais and Jamie form an unlikely partnership when they're accused of a crime they didn't commit.

episodes.title: The Possession
episodes.summary: Richard Watterson seems supernaturally attached to his old refrigerator.

episodes.title: The Master
episodes.summary: The Wattersons play a fantasy role-playing board game to resolve their differences.

episodes.title: The Silence
episodes.summary: Have Gumball and Darwin finally run out of things to say to each other?
